avatarGroup.$description: An overlapping stack of Avatars with a trailing '+N' overflow chip — the group-message 'M +35' recipient stack is its driving use case. Composes the real Avatar component (its diameters/initials/hues), and owns only the stacking recipe: how far each avatar overlaps the previous, the ring that keeps overlapping avatars visually separate, and the overflow chip that stands in for the hidden remainder. Sizes mirror Avatar's own sm/base grid. No presence dot (deferred with Avatar's own).

diameter.$description: 32px = Avatar sm's own diameter (dim.8); kept in lockstep with it so a stack lines up with a lone sm Avatar.

overlap.$description: 10px — each avatar shifts left by this much (marginLeft: -overlap), overlapping ~1/3 of the previous, the near-universal stack density.

ring.$description: A ring drawn around every avatar in the stack (and the overflow chip) so overlapping circles read as distinct — surface-colored, so it looks like a gap punched out of whatever sits behind. This sits on top of Avatar's own 1px border.default hairline.

overflow.$description: The trailing '+N' chip standing in for avatars beyond the visible cap. A same-diameter circle in a quiet neutral fill with secondary ink — reads as 'more', not as another person. Uses fill.neutral (gray.100), the same pale neutral Button-secondary rests on.
